paragraphs.text: Layered, restorable context management for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic tool-output cards, model-
written folds in three tiers, a local archive, decompress and search.
# DSH Strata
**English** | 简体中文
Layered, restorable context management for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Repository: <https://github.com/light-cheng/dsh-strata>
Old context is not thrown away. It sinks through layers, like sediment, and every layer can be broug
ext is not thrown away. It sinks through layers, like sediment, and every layer can be brought back:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **L1 tool cards**: deterministic, no model call, cut at every turn end.
- **L2 folds**: the model
writes its own summaries of older ranges, and folds can be folded again (T1 → T2 → T3). When the mod

el ignores the reminders, Strata folds the oldest work itself into an automatic digest.
- **L3 archi
ve**: every original is saved locally before anything is replaced; `decompress` and `search_context`
ginal is saved locally before anything is replaced; `decompress` and `search_context` bring it back.
## Features
- **Deterministic tool cards (L1)**: at the end of each turn, the newest finished stretch of tool ou
tput is replaced by a card that keeps errors, commands, exit codes and archive pointers. No model ca

ll; the bytes before the cut stay identical, so the prefix cache keeps hitting.
- **Model-written fo
lds in three tiers (L2)**: the model calls `compress` with a range from `strata_status` and its own
summary. A range that contains earlier folds becomes the next tier, up to T3. Folds are validated im

mediately and land together at turn end.
- **Cost-aware landing**: before a fold lands, Strata weigh
s the one-time cache miss against the tokens it saves for the rest of the session. A small or unprof
itable fold waits, and the tool result says so in its first line; above 75 % of the window folds lan

d regardless.
- **Tier-by-tier recovery**: `decompress` walks T3 → T2 → T1 → card → original one lev
el at a time, or straight to the originals with `full: true`; `toFile: true` writes large restores t

o `.strata/restore/`.
- **Local search**: `search_context` runs BM25 keyword search (CJK bigrams inc
luded) over fold summaries, card originals and tool output, and shows each hit's expansion path, e.g

. `f9(T3) → f4(T2) → f2(T1) → raw call-7`.
- **Reminders that watch the right number**: L1 keeps the
total low, so Strata watches foldable tokens instead. It reminds the model when they grew by 50K re
al (provider) tokens — local estimates are converted with the session's measured ratio, which `strat
a_status` shows — on any step of a turn, not only when a new message arrives. An unanswered reminder

comes back after another 25K (12.5K above 75 % of the window).
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Folds wait until turn end so the prefix stays byte-identical for every step inside a turn; the next
turn pays one cache miss instead of several.
## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
| `strata_status({ detail? })` | Tokens per layer (raw / card / fold / full) and per tier (T1 / T2 /
T3), foldable ranges with refs such as `s00120`, upgradable fold groups, pending folds, prefix-cach

e hit rate, archive size |
| `compress({ content })` | First line `"<startRef>–<endRef> <topic>"`, t
hen the summary. Validated now, landed at turn end; returns the reclaim / cache-miss estimate, or sa

ys up front that the fold was deferred |
| `decompress({ id, full?, toFile? })` | One tier at a time
; `full: true` goes straight to the originals; accepts fold ids, card ids, tool call ids and `s00123

` session refs. Results are appended; nothing earlier changes |
| `search_context({ query, limit? })
` | Local BM25 search over this session's archive, with the tier and expansion path of each hit |
Slash command, answered in the UI language (Chinese or English):
| Command | What it does |

| `/strata` or `/strata help` | Lists the subcommands |
| `/strata status` | Short summary: context

use, layers, cache hit rate |
| `/strata detail` | Sections: overview (use, window and where it came
from, fixed overhead, provider/estimate ratio), layers, automatic folds (rule, last turn end, prote
cted tail), foldable ranges, cache and cost (hit rate; re-billed, reclaimed and estimated net saving

of the changes landed in this DSH process), recent context changes |
| `/strata detail full` | The

detail plus every message in each foldable range |
| `/strata search <words>` | Searches this sessio

n's local archive |
| `/strata purge` | Explains what would be deleted; `/strata purge confirm` dele
tes all archive files of this session (cannot be undone) |
[该节后续省略]

Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0` and Node `>=22`. The Web / Desktop presets and headless are suppo
rted; the TUI preset is not.

## Privacy and data
- Originals are written to `<DSH_HOME>/strata/<session>/` (default `~/.dsh/strata/`), directories `0

700`, files `0600`, 128 MB in total by default.
- Everything stays on this machine. Strata makes no
network requests and no extra model calls of its own; folds are written by the session's own model a

s ordinary tool calls.
- The dock reads `GET /dsh-strata/gui/status?session=…` on DSH's own Web serv
er, behind the same access check as every DSH route. It returns token counts and event kinds only, n

ever message text or archive paths.
- Superseded runtime-context snapshots (for example DSH-Mem0's r
ecalled memories) are never archived; they are replaced by a short placeholder, so deleting a memory

in Mem0 leaves no copy in Strata's archive.
- System prompts are never archived; they are rebuilt o
n every request, and a one-line `[system prompt omitted]` marks their place, so the archive keeps no

copy of, for example, DSH-Mem0's profile.
- Archives written by 0.3.0 next to DSH-Mem0 may still ho
ld recalled memories or the Mem0 profile. On the first start after upgrading, Strata scrubs them onc
e: runtime-context snapshots and `<mem0-relevant-memories>` blocks become the placeholder, `<mem0-us
er-profile>` blocks and system-prompt sections of official-summary archives are replaced too, everyt
hing else stays as it was, and a `.scrub-runtime-context-v2` marker in the archive root keeps it fro

m running again.
- Cards and folds carry archive ids, not absolute paths. `/strata purge confirm` de
letes the current session's archive.
